reason: E1 directly demonstrates acid etching and annealing forming a Pt-rich shell on a high-entropy alloy core with enhanced durability, but it is for electrocatalytic ORR, not automotive exhaust. The key premises about the treatment and shell benefits are supported only by E1, while applicability to exhaust environments and resistance to H2O/NO/aging lack direct evidence.
